findings.title: Convoluted check for moving a location onto itself
Pointer validation duplicated between resolvePointer and parsePointer
Spec status still says Draft although the feature is implemented
README says `-` is accepted only by `add`, but move/copy also accept it
Plan refers to a src/pointer.ts module that does not exist
Import of "./index.ts" fails the project's type check

New option needs TypeScript 5.7+, which the project doesn't declare
Plan body left as the unfilled template
Removing the whole document silently yields null, undocumented in README
Plan documents committed as unfilled scaffolds
